fields.name: userId
fields.description: IAM user id (OIDC sub) this preference row belongs to. One row per user; the read+write hooks filter by currentUser.id so only the owner reads/writes. Same per-user upsert pattern as UserAiConfig / UserAvatarConfig / MemberProject.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Issue Tracker scope filter: 'all' | 'mine' | 'assigned'. Replaces localStorage key 'issue-tracker:scope'. Empty string when not set; the UI defaults to 'mine'.

fields.name: device
fields.description: Issue Tracker device filter: 'web' | 'ios' | 'android'. Replaces localStorage key 'issue-tracker:device'. Empty string when not set.

fields.name: activeSession
fields.description: Last-active chat session id. Replaces localStorage key 'issue-tracker:active-session:<userId>'. Empty string when no chat session has been opened.

fields.name: customChecksJson
fields.description: JSON-encoded Array<CustomCheck> for user-defined verification scopes. Replaces localStorage key 'lattice.verification-checks.v1'. Each check has an id slug-prefixed 'custom_'. '[]' when none defined.

fields.name: repoBrowserPath
fields.description: GitHub repo-browser current path (owner/repo/branch). Replaces localStorage key 'blocks-app:repo-browser'. Empty string when no path selected.

fields.name: githubCredentialId
fields.description: MCP /api/secrets id for the user's GitHub PAT (the plaintext lives only on the MCP server). The PAT replaces localStorage key 'blocks-app:github-token'. Empty string when no PAT saved. Mirrors the Secret.passwordMasked → /api/secrets round-trip pattern from useIssueTracker.addSecret.
